ground motion duration plays an important role in the seismic response of plan asymmetric buildings and in the damage predicted by damage indices based fragility curves.

(a) the damage indices are able to capture the effect of duration of ground motion on the damage assessment; (b) damage index based fragilities developed from the interstory drifts are more sensitive to ground motion duration than those developed from the global damage indices.

(1) the duration of earthquake motions plays an important role in the damage assessment of plan asymmetric buildings; (2) the damage index based fragilities are sensitive to the ground motion duration; (3) damage index based fragile curves developed using interstory drifts are more sensitive to ground motion duration compared to those developed using damage indices; and (4) for short duration motions, the damage indices can be used to develop fragility curves for the plan asymmetric building.
